Lizzy Finds

About Lizzy

Hi, I’m Lizzy—a China-based writer with a PhD in computer science and an interest in technology, beauty, and travel. I share research-based buying guides and reviews of products I’ve personally used.

Curiosity, with a method

I enjoy understanding how products work and which details make a difference in daily life. This site brings that curiosity to technology, beauty and travel, starting with audio.

Two kinds of articles

Guides compare published specifications, official documentation and independent research. They are labelled Research-based and do not imply I have personally tested every product.

Reviews cover products I have used myself. I’ll distinguish my experience from specifications and other people’s findings. The first hands-on reviews are still to come.

How recommendations work

Editorial scores are explained judgements, not laboratory measurements. Where your priorities matter, comparison tools let you change the weights. Commission rates do not determine scores or recommendations.
